name: kipset-functional-fitness
description: An offline-first functional fitness workout library, adaptive timer, running log, and training calendar.
author: KIPSET

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/source-sync.test.mjs tests/fitness-metrics.test.mjs tests/wod-data.test.mjs tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/story-output.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron .
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist --config.directories.output=release/portable --publish never
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist --config.directories.output=release/installer --publish never
scripts.desktop:windows: npm run desktop:portable && npm run desktop:installer
scripts.desktop:mac:x64: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --config.directories.output=release/macos-x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac:arm64: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config.directories.output=release/macos-arm64 --publish never
scripts.android:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync android && npm run android:assets
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/run-gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.check:release: npm run test && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:mobile
scripts.lint: eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next --ignore-pattern desktop-dist --ignore-pattern desktop-resources --ignore-pattern mobile-dist --ignore-pattern android --ignore-pattern release --ignore-pattern public/kipset-assets
